Design Decision (ADR / Standard): All asynchronous server queries & mutations managed by TanStack Query v5
Anti-Pattern / Banned Implementation: No manual useEffect data fetching; no custom fetching cache in React Context

Design Decision (ADR / Standard): Domain client state managed by lightweight Zustand stores
Anti-Pattern / Banned Implementation: Zero application-owned React Context for mutable app state (ADR-0012)

Design Decision (ADR / Standard): Pure domain reducers hosted by Zustand vanilla or pure functions
Anti-Pattern / Banned Implementation: No business logic inside React UI components

Design Decision (ADR / Standard): Explicit storage adapters: SecureStore for session, AsyncStorage for drafts/prefs
Anti-Pattern / Banned Implementation: No sensitive auth tokens or session cookies in unencrypted AsyncStorage

Design Decision (ADR / Standard): WebSocket connections must supply Origin: kuquestmobile:// and Cookie
Anti-Pattern / Banned Implementation: Direct new WebSocket() without Origin causes 4403 rejection on staging backend
